## About

AxeomLabs is an Indian deep-tech company that designs and builds autonomous systems. We work across hardware, embedded software, robotics, artificial intelligence, and applied science research. Founded in 2024 by Harinandan J V and Abhishek A S, based in India.

## What We Build

- **Autonomous Drones (UAVs):** Fixed-wing and multirotor platforms for surveillance, mapping, delivery, and inspection. Navigation runs on-device using LiDAR, IMU, and stereo camera fusion.
- **Robotics Platforms:** Humanoid robots, ground robots, aerial robots, underwater robots, and archaeological robots. Designed for real, uncontrolled environments, not controlled labs.
- **Embedded Software & Firmware:** Bare-metal firmware, real-time operating systems, and hardware abstraction layers. Built so hardware does exactly what it needs to, when it needs to.
- **Custom Hardware:** PCB design, electronics, sensor fusion arrays, power management systems, and structural hardware for autonomous platforms.
- **Artificial Intelligence:** Research and development in General AI, Theory of Mind AI, and Self-Aware AI systems.
- **Software Development:** Web, mobile, desktop, embedded systems, and enterprise software development.
- **Operating Systems:** Real-Time OS, single-user OS, desktop OS, and embedded OS development.
- **Game Development:** Physics-based and simulation games built with real-world science as the foundation.

## Research

### Applied Technology Research (feeds directly into hardware products)
- Autonomous Navigation: SLAM and multi-sensor fusion (LiDAR, IMU, stereo camera) for GPS-denied environments. Sub-10cm positional accuracy.
- Computer Vision: Object detection, depth estimation, and scene understanding running on embedded processors. Under 15ms inference on ARM Cortex-A.
- Materials Science: Carbon fibre composites, lattice-infill printed structures, and bio-inspired geometries for lightweight airframes and chassis.
- Embedded AI: Quantization, pruning, and knowledge distillation to run AI inference on microcontrollers with under 512KB RAM.

### Scientific Research Domains
- Astrophysics and Astronomy
- Physics
- Chemistry
- Oceanography
- Earth and Environmental Science
- Biology and Biomimetics
- Rockets and Space Production
- Power and Energy Systems
- Interdisciplinary Research
- Creative Production (science communication through film, design, and interactive media)
